title: Credit Review Grid: Payment Record and the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Total-Loss Release Premium
content:
**Grid rule.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans total-loss release premium carries a payment-record adjustment from the loan's entries dated less than 12 whole months before the release: 2 points are taken off when the loan carries no late charge and no returned payment in that period; 5 points are added when it carries two or more late charges or at least one returned payment in that period; and nothing changes when it carries exactly one late charge and no returned payment. The adjustment is made to the product's partial release premium percentage before that percentage is applied once to the unit's share of principal.

## Entries read

On the equipment loan, dated less than 12 whole months before the release: late-charge fee entries, and returned payments (principal or interest payment return entries).

## The grid

| Late charges in the 12 months | Returned payments in the 12 months | Adjustment to the premium percentage (points) |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | -2 |
| exactly one | none | 0 |
| two or more | none | 5 added |
| none | one or more | 5 added |
| exactly one | one or more | 5 added |
| two or more | one or more | 5 added |

## Hypothetical illustration

On an Irrigation System Loan (partial release premium percentage 115) with a clean 12 months — no late charge, no returned payment — the percentage is taken at 113 points; with one returned payment in the period it is taken at 120.
